title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WPdreams Ajax Search…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPdreams Ajax Search Lite plugin versions up to 4.14.7. The flaw is due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection via the ajax-search-lite component.
